spellbook.finance/limitations: This tool accepts Pokemon catalog product ids. Other games return the route's not-found response.
Fair value uses independent retail source families and never treats a dealer buy bid as retail value. Null values remain unknown.
Supply change is qualified only with comparable complete snapshots. A current depth row can exist while changePct stays null.
partialScore is a factor total with incomplete coverage. A null score or incomplete response is not a ranking or recommendation.

description: Read exact identity scoped Pokemon market facts for ONE catalog product: language, finish, condition, independent retail fair value, observed supply depth, versioned SCORE factors and Limitless demand coverage. The response keeps qualified values null when source count or comparable history is missing, and names missingFields and limitations. It reports facts only; it does not rank cards, recommend an action or infer a missing source.

cardId.description: The exact Pokemon catalog product id from spellbook_printings_search, such as pokemon:tcgp:12345. Required.

name: spellbook_pokemon_market_analytics
